SDNs are a promising approach to address the dynamic nature of aerial networking.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the SDN architecture can be extended to support new types of network optimization problems, and that the SDN-based optimization can be performed at the network level, instead of the application level, to provide better network performance.

the use of SDNs for aerial networks is not just a matter of implementing the control plane in an SDN controller, but rather a matter of using SDNs as a framework for network optimizations that leverage all the available operational information.
SDN is an enabling technology for leveraging the available information in networked systems for optimizing network performance.
